027/**
028 * Multiple instances of this plugin - one for every projectile (on hit), and one for each weapon.
029 * 
030 * The goal is for the on-hit effect to fire off a lightning arc in case of a hit, and for the onfire/every frame copy
031 * of the plugin to fire off a lightning arc in case there is a miss.
032 * 
033 * @author Alex
034 *
035 */
036public class RiftLightningEffect implements OnHitEffectPlugin, OnFireEffectPlugin, EveryFrameWeaponEffectPlugin {
037        
038

040        public static float RIFT_LIGHTNING_SPEED = 10000f;
041

044        public static String RIFT_LIGHTNING_FIRED_TAG = "rift_lightning_fired_tag";
045        public static String RIFT_LIGHTNING_SOURCE_WEAPON = "rift_lightning_source_weapon";
046

048                public DamagingProjectileAPI projectile;
049        }

072        protected List<FiredLightningProjectile> fired = new ArrayList<>();
073        
074        @Override
075        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, WeaponAPI weapon) {
076//              if (!fired.isEmpty()) {
077//                      System.out.println("FIRED");
078//              }
079                if (engine != null && engine.isInFastTimeAdvance()) {
080                        return;
081                }
082                
083                List<FiredLightningProjectile> remove = new ArrayList<>();
084                
085                float maxRange = weapon.getRange();
086                for (FiredLightningProjectile data : fired) {
087                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(data.projectile.getSpawnLocation(), data.projectile.getLocation());
088                        boolean firedAlready = data.projectile.getCustomData().containsKey(RIFT_LIGHTNING_FIRED_TAG);
089                        if (dist > maxRange || firedAlready) {
090                                remove.add(data);
091                                if (!firedAlready) {
092                                        fireArc(data.projectile, weapon, null, null);
093                                }
094                        }
095                }
096                fired.removeAll(remove);
097        }
098        
099        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
100//              if (weapon.getShip() != null && 
101//                              !weapon.getShip().hasListenerOfClass(RiftLightningBaseDamageNegator.class)) {
102//                      weapon.getShip().addListener(new RiftLightningBaseDamageNegator());
103//              }
104                //projectile.setCustomData(RIFT_LIGHTNING_PROJ_TAG, true);
105                
106                projectile.getDamage().getModifier().modifyMult(RIFT_LIGHTNING_DAMAGE_REMOVER, 0f);
107                projectile.setCustomData(RIFT_LIGHTNING_SOURCE_WEAPON, weapon);
108
109                FiredLightningProjectile data = new FiredLightningProjectile();
110                data.projectile = projectile;
111                fired.add(data);
112        }

115        public void onHit(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, CombatEntityAPI target,
116                                          Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit, ApplyDamageResultAPI damageResult, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
117                
118                WeaponAPI weapon = (WeaponAPI) projectile.getCustomData().get(RIFT_LIGHTNING_SOURCE_WEAPON);
119                if (weapon == null) return;
120                
121                fireArc(projectile, weapon, point, target);
122        }
123                        
124        public static void fireArc(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, Vector2f point, CombatEntityAPI target) {
125                boolean firedAlready = projectile.getCustomData().containsKey(RIFT_LIGHTNING_FIRED_TAG);
126                if (firedAlready) return;
127                
128                projectile.setCustomData(RIFT_LIGHTNING_FIRED_TAG, true);
129                
130                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
131                
132                ShipAPI ship = weapon.getShip();
133                if (ship == null) return;
134                
135                //Vector2f from = weapon.getFirePoint(0);
136                Vector2f from = projectile.getSpawnLocation();
137                
138
139                float dist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
140                if (point != null) dist = Misc.getDistance(from, point);
141                
142                float maxRange = weapon.getRange();
143                if (dist > maxRange || point == null) {
144                        dist = maxRange * (0.5f + 0.5f * (float) Math.random());
145                        if (projectile.didDamage()) {
146                                dist = maxRange;
147                        }
148                        point = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(projectile.getFacing());
149                        point.scale(dist);
150                        Vector2f.add(point, from, point);
151                }
152                
153                float arcSpeed = RIFT_LIGHTNING_SPEED;
154                
155                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
156                if (shroud != null) {
157                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), point);
158                        from = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 90f - 180f * (float) Math.random());
159                        from.scale((0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f) * shroud.getShroudParams().maxOffset);
160                        Vector2f.add(ship.getLocation(), from, from);
161                }
162                
163
164                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
165                params.segmentLengthMult = 8f;
166                params.zigZagReductionFactor = 0.15f;
167                params.fadeOutDist = 50f;
168                params.minFadeOutMult = 10f;
169//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.7f;
170                params.flickerRateMult = 0.3f;
171//              params.flickerRateMult = 0.05f;
172//              params.glowSizeMult = 3f;
173//              params.brightSpotFullFraction = 0.5f;
174                
175                params.movementDurOverride = Math.max(0.05f, dist / arcSpeed);
176                        
177                //Color color = weapon.getSpec().getGlowColor();
178                Color color = RIFT_LIGHTNING_COLOR;
179                EmpArcEntityAPI arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(from, ship, point, null,
180                                80f, // thickness
181                                color,
182                                new Color(255,255,255,255),
183                                params
184                                );
185                arc.setCoreWidthOverride(40f);
186                
187                arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
188                arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
189                arc.setSingleFlickerMode(true);
190        
191                spawnMine(ship, weapon, point, params.movementDurOverride * 0.8f); // - 0.05f);
192                
193                
194                if (shroud != null) {
195                        DwellerShroudParams shroudParams = shroud.getShroudParams();
196                        params = new EmpArcParams();
197                        params.segmentLengthMult = 4f;
198                        params.glowSizeMult = 4f;
199                        params.flickerRateMult = 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f;
200                        params.flickerRateMult *= 1.5f;
201                        
202                        //Color fringe = shroudParams.overloadArcFringeColor;
203                        Color fringe = color;
204                        Color core = Color.white;
205
206                        float thickness = shroudParams.overloadArcThickness;
207                        
208                        //Vector2f to = Misc.getPointAtRadius(from, 1f);
209                        
210                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(from, ship.getLocation());
211                        angle = angle + 90f * ((float) Math.random() - 0.5f);
212                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
213                        dist = shroudParams.maxOffset;
214                        dist = dist * 0.5f + dist * 0.5f * (float) Math.random();
215                        //dist *= 1.5f;
216                        dist *= 0.5f;
217                        dir.scale(dist);
218                        Vector2f to = Vector2f.add(from, dir, new Vector2f());
219                        
220                        arc = (EmpArcEntityAPI)engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(
221                                        from, ship, to, ship, thickness, fringe, core, params);
222                        
223                        arc.setCoreWidthOverride(shroudParams.overloadArcCoreThickness);
224                        arc.setSingleFlickerMode(false);
225                        //arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
226                }
227                
228        }
229        
230        public static void spawnMine(ShipAPI source, WeaponAPI weapon, Vector2f mineLoc, float delay) {
231                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
232                
233                
234                //Vector2f currLoc = mineLoc;
235                MissileAPI mine = (MissileAPI) engine.spawnProjectile(source, weapon, 
236                                                                                                                          "rift_lightning_minelayer", 
237                                                                                                                          mineLoc, 
238                                                                                                                          (float) Math.random() * 360f, null);
239                if (source != null) {
240                        Global.getCombatEngine().applyDamageModifiersToSpawnedProjectileWithNullWeapon(
241                                                                                        source, WeaponType.ENERGY, false, mine.getDamage());
242                }
243                
244                
245                float fadeInTime = 0.05f;
246                mine.getVelocity().scale(0);
247                mine.fadeOutThenIn(fadeInTime);
248                
249                float liveTime = Math.max(delay, 0f);
250                mine.setFlightTime(mine.getMaxFlightTime() - liveTime);
251                mine.addDamagedAlready(source);
252                mine.setNoMineFFConcerns(true);
253                if (liveTime <= 0.016f) {
254                        DamagingProjectileAPI e = mine.explode();
255                        if (e != null) e.setWeapon(weapon);
256                }
257        }
